title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Article 266 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, on the basis of circumstances encountered in judicial practice, discussed the meaning of Article 266 of the Criminal Law and the issue of how to apply the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law to the acts of fraudulently obtaining old-age, medical, work-related injury, unemployment, maternity, and other social insurance funds or other social security benefits, and makes the following interpretation:
Whoever, by means of fraud, falsification of evidentiary materials, or other means, fraudulently obtains old-age, medical, work-related injury, unemployment, maternity, or other social insurance funds or other social security benefits shall constitute the act of defrauding public or private property as prescribed in Article 266 of the Criminal Law.
This is hereby announced.
